ns2:section.sectionText: Explores how law shapes our lives through issues like affirmative action, obscenity, net neutrality, and voting rights. Course addresses such topics in legal communication and popular culture about the law. Divided into units that take up different dimensions of communication: persuasion, media, and free speech. Learn how everything from flag burning protests to ?I?m just here so I won?t get fined? influence our understanding of how the law is made and challenged through language.
